city.name: Washington, DC
city.regionLabel: Washington, DC, Northern Virginia, suburban Maryland and a sensible drive

events.title: Mount Vernon Fall Wine Festival
events.address: 3200 Mount Vernon Memorial Highway, Mount Vernon, VA 22121
events.age: 21+ for wine; not intended for children
events.description: Virginia wine tastings, live blues and an after-hours look inside the Mansion on the Potomac. Bring a blanket for the lawn; Sunday is the remaining available festival night.

events.title: Frida…A Self Portrait
events.description: Vanessa Severo writes and performs this intimate portrait of Frida Kahlo. Opening weekend of the October 8–November 8 engagement, with a Saturday evening and two Sunday performances.

events.title: Frida…A Self Portrait
events.description: Vanessa Severo writes and performs this intimate portrait of Frida Kahlo. Opening weekend of the October 8–November 8 engagement, with a Saturday evening and two Sunday performances.

events.title: Brian Cox in The Score
events.description: Brian Cox plays Johann Sebastian Bach in Trevor Nunn’s production about the composer’s encounter with Frederick II. The official calendar offers two Sunday performances.

events.title: Measure for Measure
events.address: 201 East Capitol Street SE, Washington, DC 20003
events.description: Psalmayene 24 directs Shakespeare’s story of power and justice in the intimate Folger Theatre. Sunday’s 7:30 PM performance is designated a relaxed performance.

events.title: Measure for Measure
events.address: 201 East Capitol Street SE, Washington, DC 20003
events.description: Psalmayene 24 directs Shakespeare’s story of power and justice in the intimate Folger Theatre. Sunday’s 7:30 PM performance is designated a relaxed performance.

events.title: Hundred Days: opening weekend
events.description: The DC premiere of the Bengsons’ folk-punk musical opens this weekend. The true-story-inspired show explores love and uncertainty in a compact 75-minute performance.

events.title: Hundred Days: opening weekend
events.description: The DC premiere of the Bengsons’ folk-punk musical opens this weekend. The true-story-inspired show explores love and uncertainty in a compact 75-minute performance.

events.title: Step Afrika!: The Fruits of Our Labor
events.description: Step Afrika! marks America’s 250th anniversary with stepping, percussion and visual storytelling. Saturday evening is ASL-interpreted; Sunday has an early 6 PM curtain.

events.title: Step Afrika!: The Fruits of Our Labor
events.description: Step Afrika! marks America’s 250th anniversary with stepping, percussion and visual storytelling. Saturday evening is ASL-interpreted; Sunday has an early 6 PM curtain.

events.title: American Indian Tour at Congressional Cemetery
events.description: Historian Mark Hudson leads a guided walk honoring American Indian leaders, diplomats and delegates buried here. The tour begins at the chapel and continues over uneven grounds.

events.title: Oyster Wars 2026
events.description: The Salt Line’s annual oyster gathering brings together East Coast farms, chefs and breweries, with live music. A portion of ticket sales supports Chesapeake oyster restoration.

events.title: Jessie Ware: The Superbloom Tour 2026
events.description: Jessie Ware brings the Superbloom tour to the Wharf with dhruv opening. The venue lists an 8 PM show, making this a Saturday-night concert option.

events.title: Two Door Cinema Club with STRFKR
events.description: The Northern Irish indie band celebrates Tourist History with a Sunday stop at the Wharf. STRFKR joins the bill; the venue’s current show time is 8 PM.

events.title: Mo Lowda & the Humble: Tailing the Ghost Tour
events.description: The Philadelphia indie-rock band brings its Tailing the Ghost tour to the 9:30 Club. The venue lists the headliner at 7:30 PM; the opening set begins earlier.

events.title: Chelsea Wolfe: The Dark World Tour
events.description: Chelsea Wolfe brings her blend of dark folk, industrial and heavy music to Sixth & I, with Jonathan Hultén opening. General-admission seating in the historic synagogue.

events.title: Afrojack at Echostage
events.address: 2135 Queens Chapel Road NE, Washington, DC 20018
events.description: A late-night electronic bill at Echostage headlined by Afrojack. Official promoter ticketing also lists Green Velvet; confirm admission requirements before buying.

events.title: Brass-A-Holics
events.description: The Brass-A-Holics play the Hamilton’s Saturday-night stage. The seated downtown music room offers an intimate alternative to the larger concert venues.

events.title: Alison Brown
events.description: Banjo player and composer Alison Brown performs at the Hamilton on Sunday evening. Check the official ticket link for the remaining seating choices.

events.title: Washington Wizards vs. Detroit Pistons: preseason
events.description: The Wizards host Detroit in a preseason matchup at Capital One Arena. This is an exhibition game ahead of the NBA regular season.

events.title: Washington Capitals vs. Seattle Kraken
events.description: The Capitals host Seattle for a Sunday afternoon NHL game in Chinatown. A 5 PM puck drop leaves room for a meal nearby before or after hockey.

events.title: Raven’s Night: Arcana
events.description: Belladonna and Ken Vegas return with a dark-fusion belly-dance production for spooky season. Arcana combines theatrical dance, elaborate costumes and guest performers.

events.title: Butler’s Orchard Pumpkin Festival
events.priceLabel: $20 reserved; $25 walk-in if available; under 2 free
events.description: The 46th annual pumpkin festival offers hayrides, a corn maze, giant slides and farm play. Reserve ahead: pumpkins cost extra and walk-ins are only allowed when capacity permits.

events.title: Great Country Farms Fall Pumpkin Harvest
events.time: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; last pumpkin wagon 4:00 PM
events.description: Pick pumpkins where they grow, tackle the seasonal corn maze and explore the farm play areas. The last weekend wagon leaves at 4 PM; pumpkins are purchased by weight.

events.title: Rafi Bastos at DC Improv
events.description: The Brazilian comedian performs English-language stand-up in the Improv’s main room. The ticket price includes service charges; food or drinks to meet the two-item minimum cost extra.

events.title: Rafi Bastos at DC Improv
events.description: The Brazilian comedian performs English-language stand-up in the Improv’s main room. The ticket price includes service charges; food or drinks to meet the two-item minimum cost extra.

events.title: DC Improv Stand-Up Showcase
events.description: John Jacobs, Denise Taylor, Randy Syphax and Bob Holden share a varied stand-up bill in the intimate lounge. This weekend’s named lineup is different from the main-room headliner.

events.title: DC Improv Stand-Up Showcase
events.description: John Jacobs, Denise Taylor, Randy Syphax and Bob Holden share a varied stand-up bill in the intimate lounge. This weekend’s named lineup is different from the main-room headliner.

events.title: Alex Falcone
events.description: Alex Falcone brings his stand-up show to the Comedy Loft’s Saturday lineup. Arrive early for general-admission seating; the venue requires two food or beverage items per person.

events.title: Bo Johnson
events.description: The Seattle comedian behind Two Sailboats plays a Sunday matinee at the Comedy Loft. The venue’s own ticket page lists a 3 PM show.

events.title: Clifton Day Festival
events.address: Main Street and Chapel Road, Clifton, VA 20124
events.priceLabel: Free admission; purchases and some activities extra
events.description: The historic town fills with makers, live music, food and children’s activities for its annual fall festival. The organizer confirms this year’s event is proceeding rain or shine.

events.title: Montgomery Symphony: Fall into the Classics
events.description: Montgomery Symphony opens its season with Beethoven’s Fifth, Joseph Bologne’s Second Symphony and Salieri’s Les Danaïdes overture. A free community orchestra concert in Takoma Park.

events.title: Maryland Symphony: American Icons
events.description: Violinist Bella Hristova joins Elizabeth Schulze and the Maryland Symphony for Barber’s Violin Concerto. Gershwin and Copland complete this concert, a longer Sunday road trip from DC.

events.title: Annapolis Powerboat Show
events.address: City Dock, Dock Street, Annapolis, MD 21401
events.priceLabel: $32 adults; $10 ages 7–15; ages 6 and under free
events.description: The 54th annual in-water show fills the downtown waterfront with powerboats, marine gear and exhibitors. Sunday is its final day; allow extra time for downtown road closures and parking.
events.sourceName: City of Annapolis / Annapolis Boat Shows

events.title: Cox Farms Fields of Fear
events.description: A haunted hayride, cornfield and forest trail turn Cox Farms into a nighttime Halloween outing. Saturday tickets remain available according to the farm’s October 10 update; buy online before leaving.

events.title: Workhouse HAUNT: Dark Encounters
events.description: A theatrical haunted trail leads through the former prison campus with costumed creatures, unsettling scenes and jump scares. Timed admission is separate from the campus’s free art walk.

events.title: Workhouse HAUNT: Dark Encounters
events.description: The Workhouse’s Halloween trail continues Sunday night through the historic campus. Expect theatrical scares and timed entry; check weather notices before driving to the outdoor attraction.

events.title: Historic Flashlight Tours at the Workhouse
events.venue: Lorton Prison Museum at Workhouse Arts Center
events.description: Take a 15–20-minute guided walk through the former prison’s cellblock and unrenovated grounds. This factual history tour includes a souvenir flashlight and is ticketed separately from HAUNT.

events.title: Historic Flashlight Tours at the Workhouse
events.venue: Lorton Prison Museum at Workhouse Arts Center
events.description: A short guided flashlight walk reveals the real history of the former prison after dark. Tours run continuously, weather and HAUNT operations permitting, with a souvenir flashlight included.

events.title: Workhouse Second Saturday Art Walk
events.priceLabel: Free; food, drinks and paid attractions extra
events.description: Meet resident artists, join hands-on art activities and explore evening exhibition receptions. Dave Curtis’s Jungian Surrealism reception is part of the October edition, with a family scavenger hunt across studios.

events.title: Bat Boy The Musical
events.venue: Workhouse Arts Center, Theater in Building 3
events.age: Older teens and adults; mature content
events.description: The cult musical about a half-human, half-bat outsider plays a Sunday matinee at the Workhouse. Its dark comedy contains adult language, violence and depictions of sexual assault.

events.title: Linganore Autumn Reggae Wine & Music Festival
events.address: 13601 Glissans Mill Road, Mount Airy, MD 21771
events.description: The vineyard’s autumn music weekend closes with S.T.O.R.M. from 11 AM to 2 PM and Jah Works from 3 to 6 PM. A DJ keeps the day moving between the live sets.

events.title: Army Ten-Miler: cheer on the runners
events.time: Race waves 7:50–8:55 AM; finish-area activities through noon
events.venue: Pentagon North Lot spectator and finish area
events.address: Pentagon North Lot, Arlington, VA 22202; spectator shuttle from South Lot via Fern Street
events.priceLabel: Spectating; check source for access rules
events.age: Check spectator access and security rules
events.description: Cheer runners at the 42nd Army Ten-Miler and visit the North Lot finish festivities. Spectators can take the free South Lot shuttle; backpacks are prohibited. Race registration is sold out.

events.title: Fredericksburg Fall Arts & Crafts Show
events.address: 2371 Carl D. Silver Parkway, Fredericksburg, VA 22401
events.description: More than 200 artisans fill the convention center with handmade jewelry, woodwork, textiles and seasonal pieces. An indoor Sunday option for finding gifts and meeting regional makers.

events.title: Equality Arlington Coming Out Day Celebration
events.description: Equality Arlington marks National Coming Out Day with personal stories, entertainment and refreshments. A community gathering for LGBTQ+ neighbors and allies at Lyon Village Community House.

events.title: Dissonance Dance Theatre: Through the Dark, the Light Beckons
events.description: Dissonance Dance Theatre celebrates 20 seasons with choreography rooted in African American experiences. The program pairs returning repertoire with new works by Shawn Short.
events.sourceName: Prince George’s County Parks and Recreation

events.title: Dissonance Dance Theatre: Through the Dark, the Light Beckons
events.description: Dissonance Dance Theatre celebrates 20 seasons with choreography rooted in African American experiences. The program pairs returning repertoire with new works by Shawn Short.
events.sourceName: Prince George’s County Parks and Recreation

events.title: Wheaton Passport to Sports Day
events.priceLabel: $10; skate rental and tennis racquets included
events.description: Try skating, tennis, pickleball and field sports across three park facilities. Collect stamps in an activity passport for a prize drawing; beginner help and equipment rentals are included.

events.title: Harmony Hall: artists’ reception afternoon
events.description: Two public receptions share this Sunday afternoon: Michele Banks’s science-inspired Forces of Nature paintings and Jeff and Kristin Bohlander’s mixed-media exhibition To Have & To Hold.
events.sourceName: Prince George’s County Parks and Recreation

events.title: Rock Spring Recital Series: Choral Gems
events.description: Shannon Arnold, Trevor Tran and fellow local singers perform choral favorites and new works. Donations at this benefit concert support Virginia Interfaith Center for Public Policy and Campaign Legal Center.
